newsitem.title: USA: Tomkins to buy Stant for $21.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins to buy Stant for $21.50/shr.

text.p: Tomkins Plc said Wednesday it had signed an agreement to acquire Stant Corp for $21.50 cash per share, or a total of $406 million.
It said it would also assume $200 million of Stant debt.
Tomkins said it had signed an agreement with Bessemer Capital Partners LP of New York, which owns 56.9 percent of Stant, under which Bessemer will tender its Stant shares to Tomkins.
Tomkins said it would cover its Stant offer with existing cash resources. The deal is expected to close by mid-May, it added.

Stant makes automotive windshield wiping systems, wiper blades, closure caps and engine thermostats, Tomkins said. It also makes a variety of other automotive products including hose clamps, heaters, grease guns and tools.
Stant had sales totaling $657 million in 1996 and expects an increase to $706 million in 1997, Tomkins said.
"Stant is an excellent acquisition for Tomkins and will complement the Gates Rubber Co...(a manufacturer) of power transmission belts, hose and connectors," it said.
Tomkins said Stant's board had postponed its annual stockholder meeting, which had been set for April 30.
